about:
# Readycheck

The complete character toolkit for WoW Classic: reminders, consumables, gear
and trinket swaps, world buffs, raid setups, time-to-kill and more.
Runs on Classic Era, TBC Anniversary and WoW Forever.

Type **/rc** in game to open it.

## Install

The easy way is an addon app that keeps it up to date for you:
**CurseForge**, **WowUp** or **Wago**.

By hand: download the zip from the newest release, and put
every `Readycheck*` folder inside it into
`World of Warcraft\_classic_era_\Interface\AddOns` (or the `_anniversary_`
folder for TBC). Restart the game.

## Updates

Addon apps update Readycheck for you. In game, Readycheck tells you once
per session when someone in your guild or group has a newer version.

## Problems or ideas

Open an issue and say what you did, what you expected, and
any error text you saw.

releases.notes:
## Readycheck 5.0.13 - Cooldowns after a PC restart

### Fixed
- A cooldown that began before your PC was restarted could show as a full cooldown on trinket, consumable and item timers. It shows the time really left.

## Readycheck 5.0.12 - Gear by spec and stance, and a size for every piece on screen

### Added
- Gear Manager, Spec & Stance: say which specs and stances or forms each gear set and item is for, and the dockable buttons' menus list only what fits what you are doing. For every class. Off until you turn it on.
- Gear sets can go on by themselves when your stance, form or spec changes. In a fight the swap waits for the fight to end, and a rule's Macro button makes one key that changes stance and weapons together. Off until you turn it on.
- One size for everything Readycheck puts on screen: the Size slider in move mode.
- Move mode: each piece has its own size. Pick a piece to change its scale, or its width, height, icon size and spacing.
- Appearance: borders can be a hairline or grow with the UI scale.

### Changed
- Borders and thin lines are one screen pixel wide at every UI scale.

### Fixed
- Reminders, dock buttons and other pieces could draw over the open world map. They go behind it now and come back when it closes.
- Songflower timers could be up to ten seconds late.
- The reminder popup's icon size and spacing apply at once, and move mode shows the popup at its real size.
- Changing a piece's Scale on its page moved the piece. It stays in place.

## Readycheck 5.0.11 - Icon sizes for nameplate debuffs

### Added
- Nameplates: each debuff group has its own icon size, and icon rows have a setting for the space between icons. Until you set one, the icon follows the text size as before.

### Fixed
- An error at login when another addon's copy of a shared library was broken. The minimap button loads anyway.

## Readycheck 5.0.10 - Smart keys for bosses, World Buff Drops, and a window look you can pick

### Added
- Smart keys: link a bar button to an ability on a boss's page. On a boss where that ability is switched off the button does nothing; everywhere else it works as you made it. Click a button on a preview of your bars to link it, or tick Automatic to have it found.
- A linked button reads WAIT on your bars until that ability's reminder goes off on the boss.
- A boss's new Macros page, and a route step, can switch a smart macro, a group of them or a bar slot to one item, such as the potion for that boss. Smart macros can be put in groups.
- World Buff Drops page: which of your characters can still hand in a head or heart, and which already have. It lists level 60s to start with; pick a lower level to see more.
- A raid config can hide your damage meter's windows while you are in that raid: Manage, "Damage meter...". The meter keeps counting, and the windows come back when you leave or pick another config.
- Appearance: a "Window look" card. Pick a finish preset or set the depth, outlines and texture yourself, and choose button depth, the main button's look, wheel speed and smooth scrolling.
- After the raid: buffs that are not on you keep their place, dimmed, so the icons do not move when you click one off. Settings pick which are shown and how dim.
- After the raid: the window shows the Chronoboon's cooldown. A setting keeps the Boon button live during it.

### Changed
- Readycheck's windows have raised title bars, and every dialog's main button has the gold face.
- The What's New window is smaller and scrolls.
- Consumables bar: the Horde mode option is gone. "Weapon stones on this bar" turns its weapon buttons on or off. The main hand button starts hidden only for Horde on Classic Era.
- Raid consume reminders start switched off on a new profile.
- Smart Macros has its own icon.

### Fixed
- The mouse wheel moved the settings window only part of a notch. Popups and lists scroll smoothly as well.
- On a raid's pages the content scrolled under the window's corner buttons.

## Readycheck 5.0.9 - Windows and buttons with more depth

### Added
- A chat line when your Darkmoon Faire lockout is pushed off. It has its own row, "Lockout pushed off", with the other alerts.

### Changed
- Readycheck's windows have a little shading and a lit top edge instead of one flat colour.
- Buttons and the sidebar's page rows stand out more: a brighter raised face, a clearer outline and a thin shadow underneath.
- Popup buttons are raised like every other button. The main choice has a gold face, a destructive one a red face.

### Fixed
- The Darkmoon Faire lockout leaves the world buff board as soon as a full debuff bar pushes it off, and no longer comes back.
